name_en: Mehikari no karaage — deep-fried greeneye, bones and all, from the waters off Nobeoka
summary_ja: 延岡市沖の日向灘、水深300m前後でとれる小魚メヒカリを、骨ごとまるごと揚げる料理。かつては雑魚扱いだったが、淡白な身とふんわりした食感を地元の料理人が引き出し、いまや延岡の名物になった。
summary_en: Mehikari — a small, big-eyed greeneye hauled up from around 300 meters deep in the Hyuga Sea off Nobeoka — is fried whole, bones included. Once treated as a throwaway catch, its mild flesh and soft texture were drawn out by local cooks and it has since become a Nobeoka specialty.
source_title: めひかりの唐揚げ 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ocha no ha tempura — new tea leaves battered and fried, salted straight from the oil
summary_ja: 摘みたての新茶の若葉に薄く衣をつけてさっと揚げ、塩を振っていただく宮崎の初夏の料理。日照時間の長い宮崎は茶どころとして知られ、新茶の時期にしか味わえない地元ならではの一品とされる。
summary_en: Freshly picked new tea leaves are dipped in a thin batter, fried quickly, and salted straight from the oil — an early-summer dish from sun-drenched, tea-growing Miyazaki, a taste available only for the brief window when the first tea leaves come in.
source_title: お茶の葉天ぷら 宮崎県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
